description:
Every product in your home once had a version that cost nothing.

Before the cleaning industry, there was a $0 formula that cleaned everything. Before the food preservation industry, there was a method that kept meat fresh for two years without electricity. Before the home repair industry, there was a $2 treatment that made wood last 200 years.

Your grandparents knew all of it. Then the consumer products industry — worth $2 trillion today — spent 80 years making sure you'd forget.

This channel shows you exactly what they replaced, what it cost, and how to make it yourself — starting today, for almost nothing.
